title: atalantia malabarica
intro: Atalantia malabarica, commonly known as the Malabar plum or Indian plum, is a species of fruit-bearing tree native to the Western Ghats of India. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Atalantia malabarica are attributed to its ability to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
